content.user_title: Find ADU Concept Plans and Download Links
content.value_statement: Finding small dwelling layouts with useful download formats can require searching several sources. This skill guides searches and comparisons within the AI Architectures plan library.
actual_capabilities: Search the connected plan library using ADU as the query and 1,200 square feet as the default maximum area.
Apply bedroom, story, and garage filters when the user requests them.
Present three to six matching plans with names, areas, bedrooms, bathrooms, stories, floor plan images, and page links.
Retrieve a selected plan by slug and provide available PDF, DXF, IFC, and GLB download links.
Relax one filter at a time when no plans fit and explain each change.
Convert area requirements using the documented approximation of 10.76 square feet per square meter.
limitations: Searches require a compatible client and access to the external AI Architectures MCP service.
Results, download availability, pricing, and account requirements depend on the external library and were not independently verified.
Plans are concepts, not permit documents or construction documents, and do not establish local code compliance.
Custom drawings require the separate floor-plan-cad skill; this skill provides no drawing engine.

use_cases.title: Compare Backyard Cottage Layouts
use_cases.description: Find small dwelling concepts and compare area, room counts, and floor plan images before seeking professional advice.

use_cases.title: Collect Editable Concept References
use_cases.description: Select a promising layout and retrieve available DXF or IFC links for further professional evaluation.

use_cases.title: Shortlist Small Rental Concepts
use_cases.description: Compare one-bedroom and two-bedroom concepts within an area limit without treating library results as site feasibility assessments.

prompt_templates.title: Browse ADU Concepts
prompt_templates.prompt: Find three to six ADU concept plans under 1,200 square feet. Show floor plan images, key dimensions when available, and page links.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: explore the library without extra filters.

prompt_templates.title: Filter a Shortlist
prompt_templates.prompt: Find one-bedroom, single-story ADU plans under 800 square feet. Compare area, bathrooms, floor plan images, and page links.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: apply explicit size and room requirements.

prompt_templates.title: Retrieve Selected Downloads
prompt_templates.prompt: For the plan with slug [plan slug], retrieve the available PDF, DXF, IFC, and GLB links. Identify any unavailable formats.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: inspect one selected library plan.

prompt_templates.title: Manage Conflicting Constraints
prompt_templates.prompt: Search for two-bedroom, single-story ADUs under 90 square meters with a garage. Convert the area limit to square feet.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: if no plans fit, ask which filter to relax, then change one filter at a time.

output_examples.input: Search for one-bedroom ADUs under 70 square meters.
output: Search criteria: ADU, one bedroom, maximum area approximately 753 square feet.
No story or garage filter requested.
Requested comparison: plan name, area, bedrooms, bathrooms, stories, floor plan image, and page link.

output_examples.input: Can I submit one of these plans for a building permit?
output_examples.output: These plans are concepts, not permit or construction documents. A licensed professional must evaluate the design against local codes and site requirements.

best_practices: Confirm that you trust the external MCP service before adding its connector.
State area units and required filters explicitly, then review any proposed filter changes.
Have a licensed professional review the selected concept and local requirements before using it for a building project.
anti_patterns: Treating concept downloads as approved permit sets or construction documents.
Assuming every requested combination of area, bedrooms, stories, and garage exists in the library.
Expecting custom drawing generation without the separate floor-plan-cad skill.

faq.question: Where do the plans come from?
faq.answer: The skill searches the AI Architectures plan library through its remote MCP service.

faq.question: Is an account required?
faq.answer: The source states that the library is free and needs no account. Current service terms and access were not independently verified.

faq.question: Which download formats can it provide?
faq.answer: The workflow requests PDF plan sets, DXF, IFC, and GLB links for a selected plan. Availability depends on the service response.

faq.question: Can I specify measurements in square meters?
faq.answer: Yes. The instructions use approximately 10.76 square feet per square meter when converting the search area.

faq.question: What happens when no plans match?
faq.answer: The workflow relaxes one filter at a time and identifies each change. It can also suggest the separate floor-plan-cad skill.

faq.question: Are the plans ready for construction?
faq.answer: No. They are concepts only. Local codes and a licensed professional determine what can be built.
